text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: This plushie is so cute and quite comforting to hold.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It reminds me of the teddy bear my parents gave to me when I was quite young…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I should have my parents send her to me. It would be nice to display them both side-by-side.
